messages:
Ellen (Marketing Ops): quick heads up - weekly KPI board shows an unexpected bump in APAC demo conversions for the launch cohort (yesterday, around 02:00 UTC). not in paid spend. anyone tracking partner form imports? :confused:
Sam (Growth): saw that spike. organic traffic looks normal but partner_referral has a big cluster. could be duplicate partner POSTs.
Rita (Analytics): running a quick join. looks like some partner payloads were re-sent from their webhook retry logic. query I ran:
```
SELECT partner_referral, count(*) as hits, count(distinct lead_id) as unique_leads,
       min(event_time) as first_seen, max(event_time) as last_seen
FROM partner_webhooks
WHERE event_date = '2026-03-25' AND partner_referral LIKE '%apac%'
GROUP BY partner_referral
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Rita (Analytics): one partner (acme-events) shows 600 hits but only 180 distinct lead_id -> clear duplicates. their webhook retried with slightly different payload_id but same email.
Alex (PR): that's the partner we used for registration promo in APAC. if numbers are inflated we should not call out region-specific lift in the press note.
Ellen (Marketing Ops): agree. can we surface both "as-counted" and "normalized" (deduped by email+normalized_ts) in the KPI deck and press numbers?
Rita (Analytics): yes. quick normalization plan: 1) dedupe by lower(email) and canonicalize timestamps into UTC minute bins 2) produce comparison panel. temp SQL snippet for dashboards: `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lower(email) || '_' || date_trunc('minute', event_time)) as normalized_conversions`
Sam (Growth): can we also add a transient filter to the dashboard to exclude partner_referral = 'acme-events' until we get cleaned data? want to avoid misleading trend lines for stakeholders scanning the top-level slide.
Rita (Analytics): staging patch: added checkbox filter and updated panel. deployed to staging at 1759123500. link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/panels/1822/apac-cohort-compare.png
KPI-Bot: deploy log: staging update requested by Rita at 1759123500  status: succeeded at 1759123560.
Alex (PR): thanks Rita. for the PR note we'll say: "APAC cohort showed elevated demo conversions; normalization reduced the uplift once duplicate partner events were reconciled." short and factual.
Ellen (Marketing Ops): action items: 1) Rita follow up with Acme to stop retries and provide corrected CSV (RITA-453) 2) Sam pause any APAC-specific callouts in the launch post 3) Alex hold regional phrasing in press note 4) KPI-Bot add a stamp to the KPI deck noting "partner import normalization applied"
Sam (Growth): pinged Acme ops for a corrected export and asked them to toggle retry logic. ETA 3h.
Rita (Analytics): uploaded normalized vs raw table to /reports/launch/1759123456-normalize.csv and pasted quick numbers: raw=790, normalized=195 (roughly 4x duplication). will update final slide once partner provides clean file.
KPI-Bot: note added to weekly-kpi: "partner import normalization applied; see panel 3 for details" at 1759123650.
Ellen (Marketing Ops): great. Alex -- once Rita drops final slides, please add one sentence to the launch post explaining methodology. keep it 1 line.
Alex (PR): will do. suggested copy: "Metrics shown include a normalization step to de-duplicate partner-sourced registrations; raw counts are available for audit."
Sam (Growth): long term: let's add a partner ingestion contract item: require unique_id and retry-id in webhook payloads so we can dedupe at ingest. opening ticket MGMT-3201.
Rita (Analytics): noted. also adding a lightweight alert: if raw/normalized > 1.2 for any partner for a single day, auto-notify #marketing and #eng-data.
Ellen (Marketing Ops): thanks team. closing this thread when PR goes live and Acme confirms fix. :white_check_mark:
